children: Shares of Reliance Industries climbed 2 per cent on the stock exchanges on Wednesday as its digital arm Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213-crore initial public offering achieved full subscription in just 100 minutes of opening, setting a record for the fastest subscription of a public issue.

The scrip of Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) jumped as much as 1.96 per cent to ₹1,225.60 apiece on the National Stock Exchange (NSE). In intraday trade, it gained 2.68 per cent to hit a high of ₹1,234.30 apiece.
The scrip of RIL was traded higher by 1.83 per cent at Rs 1,224.85 apiece on the BSE. It jumped 2.64 per cent to hit a high of Rs 1,234.60 apiece in the intraday session.

title: RIL's stock climbs 2% as Jio Platforms IPO achieves full subscription in just 100 minutes
